buttons.label: Open doors
buttons.script: for (const castle of objects.getAll('castle')) { if (castle.definition.id === 'entrance-castle') castle.testEntranceOpenAmount = 1; }

buttons.label: Close doors
buttons.script: for (const castle of objects.getAll('castle')) { if (castle.definition.id === 'entrance-castle') castle.testEntranceOpenAmount = 0; }

buttons.label: Automatic doors
buttons.script: for (const castle of objects.getAll('castle')) { if (castle.definition.id === 'entrance-castle') castle.testEntranceOpenAmount = null; }

buttons.label: Entrance view
buttons.script: camera.setFirstPerson(false); camera.setViewport({"zoom":4.5,"rotation":2,"panZ":-6,"panX":-1});

buttons.label: Inside wall view
buttons.script: const castle = objects.getAll('castle').find(c => c.definition.id === 'entrance-castle'); camera.setFirstPerson(false); const hero = objects.getOne('hero'); const origin = castle.definition.buildPlan.metadata.runtime.residential.origin; const yaw = origin.yaw * Math.PI / 180; hero.teleport({x: origin.x + Math.sin(yaw) * 2, y: origin.y + 0.014, z: origin.z + Math.cos(yaw) * 2}); hero.firstPersonCameraEnabled = true; hero.firstPersonFacingYaw = origin.yaw + 180; camera.setFirstPerson(true);

buttons.label: Castle overview
buttons.script: camera.setFirstPerson(false); camera.setViewport({"zoom":1.3,"rotation":2,"panZ":0,"panX":0});

buttons.label: Pursue royal
buttons.script: for (const e of objects) { if (e.definition?.id === 'hammerhead-brute-test') { e.resumeBehavior(); } }
